body: Adversarial review round 10 (codex): (1) audit.mjs loads packageTreeSha512 from the signed trust store but, when a tarball is available, never compares the tarball-derived reference tree digest to it; enforce equality whenever the anchor is present (new top-level assertReferenceTreeMatchesAnchor, tested through the vm extractor like the other parity functions). (2) skills/modernize/SKILL.md (and mirrors) still describe agy 1.2.8 / ADLC 1.11.1 and the 1.2.8-1.11.1 roadmap as the active targets; reword to the dynamic target arguments and the roadmap-agy-<agy>-adlc-<adlc>.md naming, and add a test that the skill text does not hardcode the old roadmap file name. Declined and flagged to the owner instead: the offline isLocalRoadmap substring marker (pre-existing, commit 5532251, operator-controlled env). Acceptance: npm test green; new tests fail without the change.
title: Enforce the signed package-tree digest and de-stale the skill text
